clinician.trajectory_summary: A 54-year-old female presented with right-sided neck pain on day 1, followed by an erythematous, vesicular rash on day 4, initially misdiagnosed as contact dermatitis. Over days 4-9, she developed a right earache and headache, and the rash spread. By day 12, a similar rash was noted along the auricle. On day 14, she developed partial right-sided facial paralysis and was diagnosed with Ramsay Hunt Syndrome in the Emergency Room. Treatment with Valacyclovir (extended to 10 days) and prednisone was initiated. By day 46, she showed significant improvement with symmetrical smile and complete right eye closure.
